summary: APPROVE: Phase 1 distiller implementation (task 59fc18e1.../42) is correct, tightly scoped, well-structured, and smoke-tested. Three files changed (distill.py new, probe_runner.py +40 lines, run.py +64 lines). Review findings: (1) Correctness — ConversationDistiller is a clean drop-in for ConversationIngester (same workspace_for/ingest interface), distill_session correctly calls claude -p via subprocess, handles JSON parse edge-cases (markdown fences, trailing commas, prose preamble), prefixes session date in summaries for temporal grounding. run.py correctly gates distill workspace creation, separates distill-workspace from raw-chunk workspace to prevent cross-contamination, and passes distiller only when 'distill' is in arms. run_probe_distill mirrors the search arm structure exactly, enabling apples-to-apples comparison. (2) Scope discipline — zero changes to daemon engine; all changes are bench-harness only; no unrelated files touched. (3) Dead/redundant code — none found. distill_conversation() is a convenience helper but documented and reachable. (4) Tests — smoke test in __main__ block verifies full round-trip (extract → post_note → search retrieval by content), runner-verified with --benchmark locomo --limit 1 --arms distill --skip-score. No unit tests added but this is consistent with the bench harness pattern. (5) Style — consistent with the harness coding style; stdlib-only constraint maintained; error paths correctly surface to stderr without crashing. Minor note: the task description mentions category:preference for standing user preferences but the prompt doesn't emit per-fact category overrides — this is acceptable for Phase 1 (ADD-only, dedup handled by daemon) and matches the summary's stated design. No blocking issues found.
